[[File:LancePolearm.png|350px|thumb|A lance]]
'''Lances''' were long, heavy, pointed melee weapons carried by mounted soldiers. [[Don-Wan Kihotay]] carried such a weapon while riding a small [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].
